{{Quote|Master Yoda, I have your&mdash;lightsaber... Which you clearly do not require.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="The Guns of Nar Hekka">{{TCWComicCite|6.13|The Guns of Nar Hekka}}</ref>}}
'''Yoda's lightsaber''' was the weapon carried by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|Its blade was shorter]] than that of a normal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to match Yoda's small stature, and was [[Color/Legends|green]]. He used this blade to perfect all styles of lightsaber combat, most notably [[Form IV/Legends|Form IV: Ataru]].

==History==
[[File:Air-Yoda.png|thumb|left|300px|Yoda wielding his lightsaber]]
Yoda used the lightsaber in numerous battles and skirmishes in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The lightsaber saw action in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] against [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]<ref name="Episode II" /> and also saw use on missions to [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]],<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]],<ref name="Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]],<ref name="CW15">{{CW|15}}</ref> [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]],<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref> and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CW23">{{CW|23}}</ref>

The Jedi Master used this weapon in a [[Skirmish in the Senate|duel]] with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] in the Senate Building in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. When the Dark Lord used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to disarm him, Yoda lost the lightsaber, which fell to the ground below,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> but he recovered the weapon, and kept it in a box in [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|his hut]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] while in his exile.<ref name="Worlds">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], a Jedi named [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]] visited Yoda on Dagobah.<ref name="Unsung">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 2: Unsung Heroes of the Light}}</ref> Yoda gave Rahn an orange lightsaber. When [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] killed Rahn, he gave the lightsaber that Yoda gave Rahn to [[Picaroon C. Boodle|Pic]]. Pic used this lightsaber to duel [[Kyle Katarn]], who killed him<ref name="DF2" /> and then left the lightsaber behind.<ref name="Peas">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The lightsaber that Yoda gave Qu Rahn is described as orange in ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''<ref name="DF2" /> and Yoda's lightsaber is shown to be yellow in ''[[Yaddle's Tale: The One Below]]'',<ref name="YT" /> but {{Film|II}} established that it's green.<ref name="Episode II" />

The hilt of Yoda's lightsaber was designed for [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']]. It was later used by Yoda in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The computer-generated model of Yoda's lightsaber in the film differs slightly from the original model.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
